text:
We piloted an AI note-taker with our field sales team for one quarter. Here's what we learned.

**1. Reps got time back.** Post-call admin dropped from about 25 minutes to under 10. That's real selling time returned.

**2. CRM data got better, not just faster.** Next steps and decision-makers were captured consistently, so pipeline reviews stopped relying on memory.

**3. Customers noticed.** Asking for consent up front built trust. One buyer said it showed we were serious about following through.

**4. Adoption needed coaching.** Reps who reviewed summaries within an hour got the most value. Those who ignored them saw little change.

**5. Not every setting works.** Noisy job sites and in-person walkthroughs still needed manual notes.

Our takeaway: AI doesn't replace judgment. It frees reps to use it.

What has your team learned?
